name: Araknia
bio: Hidden deep within the crypts of Sildrea's family is a shrine dedicated to Araknia, the Netherqueen. Formed centuries ago by some of the first Nocturna, many believe Araknia weaves the threads of fate, divining Amara's future in her glittering strands. She is said to have foretold that the New Blood would triumph in their revolution – though that's only half the story...

effects.label: DEF Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Defense stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Hex
effects.description: If killed while under this debuff, the recipient of the debuff cannot be Revived.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: ATK Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Chain
effects.description: The recipient cannot move, but can still use Combo Attacks, Active and Ultimate Skills, and Invoke their Titan.The Chain debuff is removed if the recipient Invokes a Titan.

effects.label: Disable
effects.description: Prevents the recipient from using Active Skills.
